Conținut:
Four NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 models, three other new models, API key scopes, and GTC Berlin.  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

https://deepinfra.com November 2026

Here’s what's new on DeepInfra: four NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 models, other trendy models, scopes for API keys, and a note from GTC Berlin.
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5


** Four Nemotron 3.5 models added.
------------------------------------------------------------

NVIDIA released several Nemotron 3.5 models in October, and each was available on DeepInfra on its release day. Together they cover image and document understanding, retrieval, and speech.
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 models: Super VL, Embed, Rerank and Transcribe

Super VL (https://deepinfra.com/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL) is a multimodal model that takes text, images, documents, and video as input and supports reasoning and tool calling. Embed (https://deepinfra.com/nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Embed-8B-BF16) and Rerank (https://deepinfra.com/nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Rerank-8B-BF16) are retrieval models: Embed indexes text and document images in the same search space, and Rerank scores retrieved results against a query. Transcribe (https://deepinfra.com/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B) converts up to an hour of audio into timestamped text in 40 languages.

Super VL release post → (https://deepinfra.com/blog/nvidia-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-release)

Embed and Rerank release post → (https://deepinfra.com/blog/nvidia-nemotron-3.5-embed-rerank-release)

Transcribe release post → (https://deepinfra.com/blog/nvidia-nemotron-3-5-transcribe-release)
Other new models


** Three more models in the catalog.
------------------------------------------------------------
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (https://deepinfra.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017) is an update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. DeepSeek reports higher scores on reasoning, coding, and agent benchmarks, with shorter outputs per task. DeepSeek logo
GLM-5.3-Flash (https://deepinfra.com/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash) from Z.ai is the first model in the GLM-5 series to accept images as well as text. It has a context window of about 1M tokens and is aimed at coding and agent tasks. Z.ai logo
Kimi-K3.1-Pro (https://deepinfra.com/moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro) from Moonshot AI accepts text and image input, has a context window of about 1M tokens, and is aimed at coding, research, and agent tasks. Moonshot AI logo

Browse the model catalog → (https://deepinfra.com/models)
API key scopes


** API keys can now be scoped.
------------------------------------------------------------

You can now limit what an API key is allowed to do. Instead of full access to the account, a key can be restricted to specific areas, such as running inference, reading billing information, or managing sandboxes and agents.

View the list of scopes → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/api-reference/authentication/get-api-token-scopes#get-api-token-scopes)
GTC Berlin


** Thank you for stopping by.
-----------------------
